Soybean, Sugarcane, Maize, Groundnut, Red Chillies etc.

are Kharif Crop.

yarn in the country. What could be the reason?

in the state.
 2. Rich pool of skilled labour is available.
 Which of the above is/are the correct reasons?

area of black cotton soil. Hence, only statement 2 is correct.
